items.name: oods-button
items.title: OODS Foundry Button
items.description: React adapter for OODS Button on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Danger/destructive uses solid bg-destructive and text-background, including hover and dark, to preserve text contrast with the team’s tokens. Primary preserves the team’s primary/primary-foreground token pair. Success and warning intents use the secondary variant; shadcn has no distinct success/warning palettes.

items.name: oods-card
items.title: OODS Foundry Card
items.description: React adapter for OODS Card on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Semantic as containers wrap the shadcn Card.

items.name: oods-status-badge
items.title: OODS Foundry StatusBadge
items.description: React adapter for OODS StatusBadge on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Status text and icons come from the OODS registry. Critical/danger uses destructive with solid bg-destructive and text-background in both themes; other tones use the team's default or secondary badge palette, without distinct status colours. compact and readOnly retain the OODS implementation's no-op behavior.

items.name: oods-tabs
items.title: OODS Foundry Tabs
items.description: React adapter for OODS Tabs on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. The tab list scrolls horizontally. overflowLabel and the OODS overflow menu are not implemented.

items.name: oods-select
items.title: OODS Foundry Select
items.description: React adapter for OODS Select on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. The visible control is a shadcn combobox, not a native select. A hidden native select preserves form values and native onChange events. Native option children, multiple, native size and native-select keyboard contracts are not supported; pass options.

items.name: oods-search-input
items.title: OODS Foundry SearchInput
items.description: React adapter for OODS SearchInput on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Search value, debounce, minimum query length and clear events retain their meanings.

items.name: oods-pagination-bar
items.title: OODS Foundry PaginationBar
items.description: React adapter for OODS PaginationBar on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Page links use anchors, not buttons; disabled links prevent navigation and leave the tab order.

items.name: oods-banner
items.title: OODS Foundry Banner
items.description: React adapter for OODS Banner on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Critical/danger uses destructive with solid bg-destructive and text-background in both themes, with its description inheriting the foreground; other tones use the team's default Alert palette. Distinct success/warning/info colours and solid emphasis are not implemented.

items.name: oods-input
items.title: OODS Foundry Input
items.description: React adapter for OODS Input on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Native input props, datetime-local normalization, label, help, validation and value callbacks retain their meanings; density uses team spacing rather than OODS pixel dimensions.

items.name: oods-textarea
items.title: OODS Foundry Textarea
items.description: React adapter for OODS Textarea on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Native textarea props, four-row default, label, help, validation and value callbacks retain their meanings; density uses team spacing rather than OODS pixel dimensions.

items.name: oods-checkbox
items.title: OODS Foundry Checkbox
items.description: React adapter for OODS Checkbox on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. The visible control is the team checkbox. A visually hidden native checkbox preserves the input ref, native onChange and form values. Native input event handlers other than onChange apply to that hidden input, not the visible control; density is metadata only.

items.name: oods-date-picker
items.title: OODS Foundry DatePicker
items.description: React adapter for OODS DatePicker on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Keeps the native date input and adds the team calendar/popover, including min, max, step, disabled and readOnly. pickerClassName/pickerStyle apply to the native input; density is metadata only.

items.name: oods-tag-input
items.title: OODS Foundry TagInput
items.description: React adapter for OODS TagInput on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Preserves the OODS text-value callbacks and displayed tag list, including record labels and authored children. The OODS contract does not create or remove tags; this adapter does not add those behaviours.

items.name: oods-status-selector
items.title: OODS Foundry StatusSelector
items.description: React adapter for OODS StatusSelector on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Preserves status/value, normalized options/states, authored children, help and native change callbacks. The visible control uses shadcn combobox keyboard interaction rather than a native select.

items.name: oods-card-header
items.title: OODS Foundry CardHeader
items.description: React adapter for OODS CardHeader on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Preserves the semantic header, heading level/as, title aliases, scalar/authored children and non-duplicated supporting copy. The team CardTitle and CardDescription supply the visual parts.

items.name: oods-price-badge
items.title: OODS Foundry PriceBadge
items.description: React adapter for OODS PriceBadge on shadcn/ui's Radix and Base UI bases. Preserves amount and currency precedence, currency minor units, label/children/value fallback and emphasis. Binding metadata props field, amountField, currencyField, intervalField and minorUnitsParameter retain the OODS no-op behavior.
